0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Trail Blazers hosting the Phoenix Suns in Portland. Shaedon Sharpe is out for Portland after knee surgery, and Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery. The Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, but they won the most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Portland a 60% chance to win.
